featured.name: Official Supporters Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
Greetings truckers!  

Are you ready for our next Supporters Convoy?  
Join us on our exclusive supporter-only convoy as we all come together to drive through the beautiful countryside of Germany, France & Belgium.
![Banner](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/8864dada-e7c5-4b13-8d3f-8c0f2dc0b630.avif)

Join us on **Saturday, 3rd October 2026**, at **17:00 UTC** **([Alternative Timezones](https://notime.zone/P-tLcOMoYAJV0))**.  

The convoy is expected to last around 90 minutes. While there won’t be any planned breaks or fuel stops along the way, feel free to pull over safely if you need to take a short break or refuel.
Feel free to comment or ask any questions in the [#patrons](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/609444023966498836) or [#supporters](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/586644869695406130) channel on our **[Discord](https://discord.gg/truckersmp)**!  

---

**This is a Patron, Nitro Booster, and Twitch Subscriber exclusive event**, which means you must have an active subscription to one of our Patreon tiers, be a Nitro Booster on our Discord, or have an active subscription to our Twitch channel.  
    
Please note that, to be eligible to join as a Twitch subscriber, **you must** be in our Discord with a connected TruckersMP account and have your Twitch account connected to your Discord profile. If you do not do this before the **1st October 2026**, you will not be able to participate.  

**Not a Patron yet, but want to participate?** It is not too late! Make sure you become one of our Patrons before the **1st October 2026**. Become a Patron **[here](https://www.patreon.com/bePatron?u=16310284)**.  

Don't forget to connect your Patreon account to your TruckersMP account. Not sure how to do this? **[Click here](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/598)**.  

**You can also subscribe to our Twitch channel [here](https://twitch.tv/truckersmp_official).**  
Don't know how to connect your Discord account? **[Click here](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/239)**.  

Note: If you boost our Discord before the 1st October 2026, you’re also eligible to participate!

Want to clip part of the convoy that you enjoy, or a funny moment? Download Medal.TV via our [affiliate link](https://ref.medal.tv/truckersmp) today!  

---

![Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/8e2b876b-4e51-487a-93ec-41f67bb41d19.avif)  

**Departure:** Mannheim, City

**Destination:** Liège, City

**DLC:** None

Don't forget to mark your attendance and review the event server rules on our **[event page](https://truckersmp.com/events/)**.

We look forward to seeing you there!

featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Diesel shortage
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul diesel to Kingman Arizona! 👀  

> Coastline Mining has an urgent shortage of diesel to run all their mining equipment and request your assistance!

The event takes place on the **26th September 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P01ZlW49IXHTy)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/37508.1787823642.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul diesel  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Coastline Mining in Kingman.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/a4ebd34d-accb-4852-9da9-5633020befb0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **San Francisco** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/120680-official-ats-convoy-animal-transporting/)**!

upcoming.description:
## TRANSFER OF RED WINE ACROSS FRANCE! 🍷
- Přeprava červeného vína napříč Francií na export!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Yn5DIgC.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited to the Wine Bottles and Grapes.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:30** - Meetup at parking slots in Bordeaux.
*  **20:00**  - Departure from Bordeaux to the Northern France.
*  **20:25** -  Passage trough the local road near Limoges.
*  **20:55** -  Arrival to the Le Havre Port.
*  **21:00** -  Convoy group photo and end of the event.

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/VEyVuVu.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Bordeaux, Dans le Jardin - Le Havre, Port De Conteneur.**

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

upcoming.description:
![](https://i.ibb.co/XNCjw1w/About-Us.png)  

Welcome to Max Logistics apart of the Broke By Design Group!
We officially opened on the 28th of April, 2025, Broke By Design is more than a group it’s a culture.
Here, we don’t just drive trucks, we show them off, love them. We also love all different styles eg,
